summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and frontend lead with over 6 years shipping production web products in React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

bullets: Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in React and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices for financial reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard.
Built features for an AI conversational commerce platform in React, spanning 3 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, and Discord.
Engineered Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS for high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the customer inbox from Redux to Jotai and added Datadog monitoring.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform aggregating cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated the legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, improving performance and SEO.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect and led a distributed frontend team.
Directed 4 technical functions: web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing.
Supervised offshore teams building React, Angular, and Node.js products, owning budgets and QA.
Recruited and hired full-stack developers, SEO analysts, and content strategists.
Led engineering through the full SDLC with hands-on review and testing standards.
Shipped Ionic apps to the Apple and Google stores with in-app subscriptions and Stripe payments.
Configured CI/CD pipelines on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase for high-frequency releases.
Architected an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend on AWS EC2, integrating Stripe Connect to power a vendor marketplace.
